objective: Improve source-acquisition precision and then full-denominator native ContextBench quality/cost, progressing to untouched matched superiority confirmation only after qualification.
hypothesis: Exact group IDs remove prefix-assembly failures, while an observation-aware available-file inventory avoids wasting localization slots on already inspected source.
distinction: A separately constructed and prospectively frozen joint source-state/interface intervention, not repair or replay of r1, and not causal identification of the two components individually. R1's failed gate, invalid choices and denominators remain unchanged.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing owner private benchmark research and GLM approval. D65 candidate research only; no product admission, activation, publication, deployment or fresh confirmation opening.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Exact catalog-ID lookup and source-observation-ledger inventory, source-only preflight, then separately frozen12-case exposed acquisition screen.
construction_boundary.runnable_product_work: Run the new bounded screen; seal all12 choices before exposed label analysis and audit the unchanged quality gate.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: WSL frozen source/evidence, verified r2 SSH reuse and fixed VPS credential relay. No credential read or copy.

construction_evidence.source_scope: All admitted tracked text paths outside the exact observed-file ledger. No language extension exclusions, dropped unobserved paths, Gold-based filtering or silent truncation. Catalog and chosen-file packet each have65536-byte caps; overflow fails closed.

prospective_screen_contract.cohort: All12 already-exposed cases in original ascending order, no replacement or confirmation opening.
prospective_screen_contract.state_binding: Use the prior matched control's sealed legitimate source observations as a declared proxy starting state. Check prediction digest and recompute observed paths before freeze. Both arms exclude that same observed set. Unlike r1, r2 filters inventory before generation. Historical selections, scores, Gold, patches, hidden reasoning and credentials are never generator inputs.
prospective_screen_contract.generator_inputs: Original issue and source-only available inventory. First reply selects one to three exact listed group IDs; second selects zero to three exact listed file paths. IDs are exact lookups, never guessed path repair.
prospective_screen_contract.comparison: Same original-issue unexpanded ranker control sealed in query-expansion r1, outside the same observed ledger. This is an exposed file proxy, not a new native control or fresh matched engine comparison.
prospective_screen_contract.denominator: Every case and all36 allocated slots remain. Invalid or empty choices are not replaced; missing source references remain in denominators. Partial/uncertain transport stops without replay and cannot qualify.
prospective_screen_contract.label_barrier: All12 choice/source identities and lead seals must verify before first isolated exposed Gold load.
prospective_screen_contract.claim_ceiling: Exposed reference-file acquisition only, not useful spans, native F1, superiority or product admission.
prospective_screen_contract.native_binding_requirement: A qualified live policy must use its own contemporaneous source observation ledger, not these task-specific historical controls. All localization calls/tokens must fit the same total native per-case budget before a separately frozen matched campaign.

execution_evidence.early_observation: All directory ID selections were valid, but case01 and02 file choices invalid. Invalid choices remained zero credited slots, without repair or retry. All12 cases completed.
execution_evidence.score_posture: Every12-case choice/lead identity was sealed and verified before Gold. Terminal execution and independent audit completed; no live r2 process remains.
execution_evidence.decision: Reject r2 native advancement. Exact IDs eliminated directory choice errors but neither reference-file precision nor file-output validity qualified. No gate relaxation or replay.
execution_evidence.post_score_attribution: The same directory choices contain13 unobserved reference-file occurrences; with at most3 choices per case, the oracle upper bound is11 hits. Actual r2 reached4. An oracle ceiling is diagnostic, not achieved precision, label feedback for inference or a qualification result.

next_candidate.mechanism: Fix source-only directory pools to the sealed r2 first-stage outputs; attach bounded issue-conditioned source declarations/line snippets to every candidate and use exact file IDs at the chooser stage.
next_candidate.scope: A distinct exposed fixed-pool ablation, not repair of r2. Shared upstream directory-generation usage must be accounted in total policy cost. No Gold-based candidate, excerpt or query selection. A future live native policy reruns its own directory stage and uses its own observation ledger.
next_candidate.product_frontier: Construct exact-ID source-card packet and tests, verify all candidate blobs and capacity, then separately freeze the12-case chooser screen.
next_candidate.operational_residue: Native integration, fresh matched DSH and untouched confirmation stay deferred, not global blockers.
